style: Precise European-engineering flat vector illustration in graphite (#161b22), teal (#00b3a4) and white, clean exact lines, no text.

subjects.voitures-europeennes: Three different generic European-style cars (a sport sedan, a hatchback and a wagon) side by side inside a clean repair bay, one on a lift. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A precise European-car repair bay: a generic sport sedan on a lift and a generic hatchback in the next bay, a diagnostic cart, teal LED strips, a spotless tool wall. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems. Flat vector, DARK graphite overall, teal highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame).
